<div class="lt512-widget">
  <svg
    class="lt512-svg"
    viewBox="0 0 867 618"
    preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    role="img"
    aria-label="Zona de Tanques Línea 5"
  >
    <defs>
      <!-- Acabado metálico -->
      <linearGradient
        id="lt512-metal-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="100%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ECEEF0" />
        <stop offset="20%" stop-color="#E2E4E7" />
        <stop offset="45%" class="lt512-metal-stop" />
        <stop offset="62%" stop-color="#E2E3E6" />
        <stop offset="84%" class="lt512-metal-stop" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C6C8CD" />
      </linearGradient>

      <linearGradient
        id="lt512-top-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#F0F1F3" />
        <stop offset="45%" stop-color="#E6E8EB" />
        <stop offset="100%" class="lt512-metal-stop" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Líquido -->
      <linearGradient
        id="lt512-liquid-gradient"
        x1="0%"
        y1="0%"
        x2="0%"
        y2="100%"
      >
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B4DCEF" />
        <stop offset="35%" class="lt512-liquid-stop" />
        <stop offset="75%" class="lt512-liquid-stop" />
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#92C3DE" />
      </linearGradient>

      <!-- Sombra suave -->
      <filter
        id="lt512-equipment-shadow"
        x="-15%"
        y="-15%"
        width="135%"
        height="140%"
        color-interpolation-filters="sRGB"
      >
        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="1.5"
          result="ambientBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="ambientBlur"
          dx="0.3"
          dy="2"
          result="ambientOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#18212D"
          flood-opacity="0.12"
          result="ambientColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="ambientColor"
          in2="ambientOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="ambientShadow"
        />

        <feGaussianBlur
          in="SourceAlpha"
          stdDeviation="0.4"
          result="contactBlur"
        />
        <feOffset
          in="contactBlur"
          dx="0"
          dy="0.7"
          result="contactOffset"
        />
        <feFlood
          flood-color="#111820"
          flood-opacity="0.15"
          result="contactColor"
        />
        <feComposite
          in="contactColor"
          in2="contactOffset"
          operator="in"
          result="contactShadow"
        />

        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="ambientShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="contactShadow" />
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" />
        </feMerge>
      </filter>

      <!-- Aletas del precalentador -->
      <pattern
        id="lt512-fin-pattern"
        width="10"
        height="12"
        patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <rect
          width="10"
          height="12"
          fill="#C5C9CF"
        />
        <path
          d="M 2 0 V 12 M 7 0 V 12"
          fill="none"
          stroke="#4E4E4E"
          stroke-width="1"
        />
        <path
          d="M 4 0 V 12"
          fill="none"
          stroke="#F0F1F3"
          stroke-width="1"
        />
      </pattern>

      <!-- Rayado de los apoyos -->
      <pattern
        id="lt512-support-pattern"
        width="6"
        height="6"
        patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"
      >
        <path
          d="M -1 6 L 5 0 M 5 6 L 11 0"
          fill="none"
          stroke="#7C828A"
          stroke-width="0.7"
        />
      </pattern>

      <!-- Flecha de flujo: apunta a la derecha -->
      <g id="lt512-arrow">
        <path
          class="lt512-flow-arrow"
          d="M 0 0 L -5 -2.2 V 2.2 Z"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Válvula manual horizontal -->
      <g id="lt512-valve">
        <path
          class="lt512-valve-body"
          d="M -9 -9 V 9 L 0 0 Z"
        />
        <path
          class="lt512-valve-body"
          d="M 9 -9 V 9 L 0 0 Z"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Válvula proporcional horizontal -->
      <g id="lt512-proportional-valve">
        <use href="#lt512-valve" />

        <line
          class="lt512-valve-stem"
          x1="0"
          y1="0"
          x2="0"
          y2="-17"
        />

        <ellipse
          class="lt512-valve-actuator"
          cx="0"
          cy="-17"
          rx="6.5"
          ry="1.5"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Bomba horizontal -->
      <g id="lt512-pump">
        <rect

          x="-14"
          y="-9"
          width="28"
          height="18"
          rx="1.5"
          ry="1.5"
        />

        <path

          height="22"
          rx="0.5"
        />

        <rect
          class="lt512-pump-body"
          x="14"
          y="-11"
          width="4"
          height="22"
          rx="0.5"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Indicador circular -->
      <g id="lt512-indicator">
        <circle
          class="lt512-indicator-body"
          cx="0"
          cy="0"
          r="10"
        />
        <path
          class="lt512-indicator-half"
          d="M -7.071 -7.071 A 10 10 0 0 0 7.071 7.071 Z"
        />
      </g>

      <!-- Recipiente pequeño de los apoyos -->
      <g id="lt512-small-container">

          x="-6"

          width="12"

        />

          cx="0"
          cy="2"
          rx="6"
          ry="2"
        />
      </g>
